params.1273: Teleport using the Home Teleport spell.
params.1274: You may use Home Teleport as often as you wish.
params.1275: Open your Magic Spellbook and click on the Home Teleport icon (an H in a circle), then select an active destination (e.g. Lumbridge) to teleport there.
params.1276: This spell costs no runes, but takes a while to cast and is interrupted if you are attacked.
params.2225: This spell provides a handy way to recentre yourself if you get lost. You can activate more lodestones as you explore to more quickly revisit major settlements.
